gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono reads sturdy and spacious, its tall lowercase keeping every letter well apart from its neighbor and every curve wide open. Delius Unicase brings a loose, hand-drawn warmth that makes the plain sans feel friendlier.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro reads dense and tall through the middle of each word, with big entrances into every letter. Delius Unicase loosens it with a hand-drawn feel.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-multa: Delius Unicase is stencil-cut, every stroke the same width from start to finish, which gives headings a quirky, handmade look. And Noto Sans Multani handles the reading, with a lofty x-height and an e left wide open at its terminal.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-myanm: Delius Unicase builds its uppercase from lines of one constant thickness, so the headings feel relaxed and hand-drawn, almost like marker lettering. Noto Sans Myanmar does the steady work below, a heavy-looking band of text.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-nabat: Delius Unicase has no swelling in the bowls of its letters, so its handwritten shapes look relaxed and inviting. Shrink it too far and that friendliness thins out.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-nag-m: Noto Sans Nag Mundari reads with lowercase that rivals its capitals, and c and s shapes that look half unwrapped. Its plain sans build gives the loose handwriting of Delius Unicase something firm to lean on.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-nandi: Noto Sans Nandinagari keeps its openings generous at every weight, with short ascenders and a big lowercase body. But Delius Unicase is the one with personality, its handwritten strokes carrying the same visual mass throughout, while the body font simply stays approachable.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-newa: Every stroke looks drawn with one fixed nib. Delius Unicase sets that handwritten, inviting tone, and Noto Sans Newa follows with a clearly open lowercase e and tall, roomy bowls.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu towers, with terminals held far back. Delius Unicase supplies the bent-paperclip charm in its headings, while the body font does the quieter job of staying clear and modern.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-ol-ch: Noto Sans Ol Chiki sets words as solid blocks rather than skylines, its curve tails held well back from the body. Delius Unicase is the playful one, drawing each handwritten stroke with no thick and thin.
